extracted.name: Chocolate chip oat cookies
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member gwaight and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup soft light brown sugar
100g chocolate (whatever kind you like) roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Cream butter and sugars, preheat oven to 180 degrees and line two baking trays with baking paper.
In another bowl add flour to oats and baking powders.
Add chocolate and add to butter and egg mixture.
Roll into 2cm balls and space about 5cm apart.
Place in the oven for 8-10 minutes.
Take out and leave in the tray for 2 minutes then transfer to cooling rack.
